## Payments and credit decisioning

Rules choose approve, review, or deny.
The model writes a rationale only for a review.
The model cannot change the decision.

Stripe amounts are cents. Plaid amounts are major units.
Velocity counters arrive on the event. This workflow does not store payment history.

Set NVIDIA_API_KEY to call NVIDIA on review cases. With no key, the mock rationale is used.
